title: LLM Latency Tracker: measured latency and uptime for AI inference APIs
description:
Independent, continuously measured latency (DNS → TCP → TLS → TTFB) and inference time-to-first-token for ~45 AI inference API providers across four regions (US Central, Europe, Asia/Tokyo, South America).

Probes run every five minutes from separate network locations and are never routed through a gateway, so the numbers describe the providers themselves rather than a proxy in front of them. This repository carries daily JSON snapshots under data/rankings/; the live dataset, the full methodology and the raw-data retention policy are published at llmlatency.dev.
